name: YPRR decomposition: TPRR x yards per target (@YardsPerGretch, via @StephenKrupka)
census_status: HOMED — an identity/framing record: it states how YPRR factors, so the reasoning layer can attribute a YPRR move to target-earning or to per-target yield instead of reading the composite raw
stamp_required: targets + routes run + receiving yards per player, as of capture
stamp_gap: framing record only; no separate series is held
probe_finding: Definition (@YardsPerGretch, as carried in @StephenKrupka's catalog, read 2026-10-15): YPRR (yards per route run) decomposes as TPRR (targets per route run) x YPT (yards per target) — efficiency per route is target-earning multiplied by per-target production. Role in-engine: a diagnostic split for C-281 and C-292 reads — when a receiver's YPRR moves, the decomposition says which factor moved (he is being targeted more, or his targets are producing more), and the two factors have different opponents (coverage/scheme drives earning; depth/role drives yield). No stamped values are claimed by this record; it is the algebra the other receiver records are read through.
